verdict.rationale: Fedora's official Workstation page says that, thanks to a global community of translators, Workstation is available in many languages, which directly matches the story of using the desktop in your own language through community translations. The support rests on a single marketing line with no further detail or independent confirmation. Missing for 10: a list of supported languages or how complete the translations are, documentation on switching the system language or input methods, and community or hands-on corroboration of translation quality.
